title: Added interactive plot and high-resolution plot download feature
description:
Interactive Plot Support
- Added new run_r_plotly_code tool that enables the AI to generate interactive plotly visualisations
- AI automatically chooses between static ggplot2 and interactive plotly based on user request or data characteristics
Download Button
- Added PNG download button in plot card header that allows plot download in 300 DPI.
Other improvements
- Added plot history
- Added dark mode
- Fixed initial mic button state to correctly reflect muted status
